entries.title: Pump Brake Horsepower (BHP)
entries.variables: ρ = fluid density, g = gravity, Q = flow rate (gpm in the second form), H/TDH = total dynamic head (ft), Eff = pump efficiency
entries.description: Shaft power a pump must be supplied to deliver a given flow against a given head.

entries.title: Pump Efficiency
entries.variables: WHP = water (hydraulic) horsepower, BHP = brake horsepower
entries.description: Ratio of hydraulic output power to shaft input power.

entries.title: Pump Affinity Laws — Speed Change
entries.variables: Q = flow rate, H = head, BHP = brake horsepower, N = pump/impeller rotational speed
entries.description: How a centrifugal pump's flow, head, and power scale when its rotational speed changes (impeller diameter held constant).

entries.title: Pump Affinity Laws — Impeller Diameter Change
entries.variables: Q = flow rate, H = head, BHP = brake horsepower, D = impeller diameter
entries.description: How a centrifugal pump's flow, head, and power scale when its impeller diameter changes (speed held constant).

entries.title: Weight
entries.variables: m = mass (kg), g = gravitational acceleration
entries.description: Earth's gravitational pull on a body.

entries.title: Specific (Unit) Weight
entries.variables: ∀ = volume, ρ = density
entries.description: Weight of fluid contained in a unit volume.

entries.title: Density
entries.variables: m = mass, ∀ = volume, γ = specific weight
entries.description: Mass of fluid contained in a unit volume.

entries.title: Specific Volume
entries.variables: ∀ = volume, m = mass, ρ = density
entries.description: Volume per unit mass of fluid — the inverse of density.

entries.title: Specific Gravity (Fluid)
entries.variables: Standard substance is water at reference conditions
entries.description: Dimensionless ratio of a fluid's density (or specific weight) to that of a standard substance.

entries.title: Compressibility and Bulk Modulus of Elasticity
entries.variables: β = compressibility, E_B = bulk modulus of elasticity, p = pressure, ∀ = volume
entries.description: Fractional change in fluid volume per unit change in pressure at constant temperature, and its reciprocal.

entries.title: Dynamic (Absolute) Viscosity
entries.variables: τ = shear stress, dU/dy = velocity gradient
entries.description: Measure of a fluid's resistance to shear (Pa·s or Poise; 1 poise = 0.1 Pa·s).

entries.title: Kinematic Viscosity
entries.variables: μ = dynamic viscosity, ρ = density
entries.description: Ratio of absolute viscosity to density (m²/s or Stoke; 1 Stoke = 0.0001 m²/s).

entries.title: Pressure (Pascal's Law)
entries.variables: F = force acting normal to surface, A = area
entries.description: Pascal's Law: pressure on a fluid is transmitted equally in all directions within a closed container.

entries.title: Absolute Pressure
entries.variables: P_atm ≈ 101.325 kPa = 14.7 psi = 760 mmHg at sea level
entries.description: Sum of atmospheric and gage pressure.

entries.title: Pressure Head
entries.variables: P = pressure, γ = specific weight of fluid
entries.description: Energy contained in a fluid expressed as an equivalent column height (head).

entries.title: Buoyant Force (Archimedes' Principle)
entries.variables: γ = unit weight of fluid, ∀ = volume of fluid displaced by the body
entries.description: A body immersed in a fluid experiences an upward force equal to the weight of the fluid it displaces.

entries.title: Flow Rate (Discharge)
entries.formula: Mass flow rate: M = ρQ = ρAV      Weight flow rate: W = γQ = ρgAV      Volume flow rate: Q = AV
entries.variables: A = cross-sectional area, V = velocity, ρ = density, γ = specific weight
entries.description: Amount of fluid passing a section per unit time, in mass, weight, or volume terms.

entries.title: Continuity Equation
entries.formula: Incompressible: Q = A1v1 = A2v2 = A3v3 = constant      Compressible: ρ1A1v1 = ρ2A2v2 = ρ3A3v3 = constant
entries.variables: A = cross-sectional area, v = velocity, ρ = density
entries.description: Conservation of mass applied to fluid flow through a pipe or channel of varying section.

entries.title: Velocity (Kinetic) Head
entries.variables: v = velocity, g = gravitational acceleration
entries.description: Kinetic energy of a flowing fluid expressed per unit weight.

entries.title: Total Flow Energy (Bernoulli Head)
entries.variables: v²/2g = velocity head, p/γ = pressure head, z = elevation head
entries.description: Sum of kinetic, pressure, and elevation energy per unit weight of fluid.

entries.title: Bernoulli's Energy Equation
entries.formula: p1/γ + z1 + v1²/2g = p2/γ + z2 + v2²/2g
entries.variables: Subscripts 1, 2 = two points along the same streamline
entries.description: Conservation of energy for a steadily flowing, frictionless fluid — total head is constant along a streamline.

entries.title: Fluid Power and Efficiency
entries.variables: Q = flow rate, γ = specific weight, E = total head
entries.description: Power delivered by/to a flowing fluid, and the resulting efficiency of a device.

entries.title: Momentum Equation
entries.formula: ΣF = ma        F_G + F_P − F_f = ρQΔV
entries.variables: F_G, F_P, F_f = gravity, pressure, friction force components, ΔV = change in velocity
entries.description: Newton's second law applied to a control volume of flowing fluid.

entries.title: Reynolds Number
entries.variables: v = velocity, D = pipe diameter, ρ = density, μ = dynamic viscosity, ν = kinematic viscosity
entries.description: Ratio of inertial to viscous forces; Re < 2000 laminar, 2000–4000 transitional, > 4000 turbulent (pipe flow).

entries.title: Prandtl Number
entries.variables: ν = kinematic viscosity, α = thermal diffusivity, C_p = specific heat, k = thermal conductivity
entries.description: Relates a fluid's momentum diffusivity to its thermal diffusivity.

entries.title: Froude Number
entries.variables: U = flow velocity, g = gravity, d = characteristic depth
entries.description: Ratio of inertial to gravitational forces; Fr = 1 critical flow, Fr > 1 supercritical, Fr < 1 subcritical (open-channel flow).

entries.title: Discharge Coefficients (Cd, Cv, Cc)
entries.formula: C_d = Q/Q_t        C_v = v/v_t        C_c = a/A        C = C_c × C_v
entries.variables: Q_t = theoretical discharge, v_t = theoretical velocity, a = contracted jet area, A = opening area
entries.description: Correction factors relating actual to theoretical discharge/velocity/area for a flow-measuring device.

entries.title: Orifice / Nozzle Discharge
entries.formula: v_t = √(2gH)      v = C_v√(2gH)      Q_t = A√(2gH)      Q = CA√(2gH)
entries.variables: H = head across the orifice/nozzle, A = opening area, C = coefficient of discharge
entries.description: Theoretical and actual velocity/discharge through an orifice or nozzle under head H.

entries.title: Weir Discharge Formulas
entries.formula: Francis: Q = 1.84LH^1.5      Francis w/ contraction: Q = 1.84(L−0.2H)H^1.5      Cipoletti (trapezoidal): Q = 1.86LH^1.5      Triangular (90°): Q = 1.38H^2.5
entries.variables: L = weir crest length, H = head over the weir
entries.description: Standard discharge formulas for common weir shapes used to measure open-channel flow.

entries.title: Darcy–Weisbach Head Loss (Pipe Friction)
entries.variables: f = friction factor, L = pipe length, D = pipe diameter, v = velocity, Q = flow rate
entries.description: Head loss due to friction as fluid flows through a pipe.

entries.title: Friction Factor (Laminar vs. Turbulent)
entries.variables: Re = Reynolds number
entries.description: Darcy friction factor used in the Darcy–Weisbach head-loss equation, by flow regime.
